candidate_grid.features: Exact original SVD128 candidate features; no feature change.
candidate_grid.model_family: Same LightGBM L1 candidate; no parameter values added or changed.
candidate_grid.tie_break: Minimum inner MAE within 1e-10; lower rank_weight first; then regularized before base, identical to Stage 5 select_inner.

protocol.full_train_selection_note: This stage does not refit on all Train and does not use 76-79 to choose a full-train recipe. Root must decide separately whether a final-policy helper using fit cycles 47-75 and validation 76-79 is needed after reviewing these temporal results.
protocol.main_review: Parent agent approved this one bounded refinement after reviewing the paired ablation: primary was near-neutral and mixed across windows, while both H12 halves improved.

metrics_and_reporting.attribution: Keep fixed paired SVD128 and inner-selected SVD128 results distinct; also compare both with the frozen SVD32 Stage 5 control.
metrics_and_reporting.primary: Same 38,588 unique canonical W1-W6 rows; raw MAE, equal-cycle MAE, per-cycle and per-window deltas, signed error, p95 absolute error.
metrics_and_reporting.secondary: H12_E and H12_L separately and pooled on the same historical development rows.
metrics_and_reporting.selection_data: Only each fold's stated inner validation labels select that fold's parameters and rank weight. Outer validation labels are used only for evaluation after selection.

outer_policy.additional_outer_fits: Refit only a selected parameter whose raw outer prediction is absent from the six original paired fits; at most one additional outer fit per cutoff.
outer_policy.control: Exact frozen Stage 5 SVD32 inner-selected predictions and exact first-stage fixed-policy SVD128 predictions.
outer_policy.reuse: Reuse each first-stage SVD128 outer raw prediction when its selected parameter matches the inner-selected parameter; apply the newly selected weight to that raw prediction.
outer_policy.validation_windows: Unchanged W1-W6 and H12_E/H12_L from first-stage protocol.

protocol.research_question: Within the same SVD128 LightGBM recipe, does selecting between the two existing LightGBM parameter sets and the existing per-cycle rank weights using past-only inner validation change the paired temporal result?
